name: alb42-nft
description: Un token ERC721 simple appelé ALB42NFT

scripts.setup: cd code && cd nft && npm install && ln -s ../code/nft/node_modules ../../../deployment/node_modules

scripts.compile: cd code && cd nft && npx hardhat compile
